core_obligations: Refine an arbitrary open covering of X by a finite disjoint union of open parts using the profinite structure (proof lines 3923-3925).
Conclude that the global section functor is exact, since surjectivity of a map of abelian sheaves can be checked on such a refinement (proof lines 3926-3928).
Apply vanishing of higher derived functors of an exact functor to obtain the statement (proof lines 3928-3930).
proof_roadmap: Vanishing of higher derived functors (proof lines 3928-3930).
difficulty_reason: For a profinite topological space X, the lemma shows that the cohomology of any abelian sheaf vanishes in positive degrees (statement lines 3916-3920). The proof uses the structure of profinite spaces: every open covering can be refined by a finite disjoint union decomposition into open parts, which makes the global section functor exact because surjectivity of sheaves can be tested on such a refinement (proof lines 3923-3928). An exact functor has vanishing higher derived functors, so the conclusion follows immediately (proof lines 3928-3930). The claim is H2: the content is the single structural observation about profinite spaces and the standard consequence for exact functors, with nothing left to the reader.
